source.text: הִנֵּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בּוֹקֵ֥ק הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבֽוֹלְקָ֑הּ וְעִוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔יהָ וְהֵפִ֖יץ יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Here! Yahweh [is] about to lay waste the earth and devastate it, and he will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants.

en.L: Look, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] about to lay waste the earth and make it desolate, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants.
en.B: Look! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is about to strip the earth bare and lay it waste; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will wrench its face out of shape and scatter the people who live on it.
en.R: Listen! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is going to empty the earth and leave it in ruins. \q He will turn its surface upside down and scatter the people who live there.

es.L: He aquí, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [está] a punto de vaciar la tierra y dejarla desolada, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} torcerá su superficie y dispersará a sus habitantes.
es.B: ¡Mira! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} va a despojar la tierra y dejarla asolada; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} deformará su faz y dispersará a los que viven en ella.
es.R: ¡Escucha! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} va a vaciar la tierra y dejarla en ruinas. \q Pondrá su superficie patas arriba y esparcirá a la gente que vive en ella.

fr.L: Voici, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va vider la terre et la dévaster, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en bouleversera la surface et dispersera ses habitants.
fr.B: Voici : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va dépouiller la terre et la ravager ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui tordra le visage et dispersera ceux qui l’habitent.
fr.R: Écoutez ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va vider la terre et la laisser en ruine. \q Il va la mettre sens dessus dessous et disperser les gens qui y vivent.

sw.L: Tazama, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [yu] karibu kuifanya dunia tupu na kuiharibu, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atauvuruga uso wake na kuwatawanya wakaaji wake.
sw.B: Tazama! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anakaribia kuivua dunia kila kitu na kuifanya ukiwa; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ataiharibu sura yake na kuwatawanya watu wanaoishi juu yake.
sw.R: Sikilizeni! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataifanya dunia kuwa tupu na kuiacha magofu. \q Atapindua uso wake na kuwatawanya watu wanaoishi juu yake.

vi.L: Kìa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sắp làm cho đất trống rỗng và làm cho nó hoang tàn, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm cong vẹo mặt đất và phân tán cư dân nó.
vi.B: Kìa! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sắp vét sạch mặt đất và làm cho nó hoang tàn; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ vặn vẹo bề mặt nó và làm tản lạc những người sống trên đó.
vi.R: Hãy nghe đây! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sắp làm cho trái đất trống trơn và đổ nát. \q Ngài sẽ đảo lộn mặt đất và làm cho dân cư trên đất phải tản lạc.

decisions.choice: the earth: the whole world, not only the land of Judah
decisions.reason: The word can mean the whole earth or one land, often the land of Israel. Here the scene is worldwide: "the world" stands beside it in verse 4, "the peoples" in verse 13, the edge of the earth in verse 16, the earth's foundations in verse 18, and the host on high with the kings of the earth in verse 21. Chapters 24-27 widen the oracles against single nations (chapters 13-23) to the whole world. Judah is included in the judgment (the priest of verse 2, the city of verse 10), so "the land" remains possible in places.

decisions.choice: lay waste and devastate: empty out and strip bare
decisions.reason: The first verb means to empty, as a jar is emptied (Jeremiah 51:2); the second, which sounds like it, means to make desolate. Verse 3 takes up the first verb again.

decisions.choice: twist its surface: distort the face of the earth
decisions.reason: The verb means to bend or make crooked (Lamentations 3:9; Ecclesiastes 7:13). It looks ahead to the shaking and splitting of the earth in verses 18-20.

decisions.choice: Look! (Balanced); Listen! (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew opens with a word that calls for attention; "behold" is not used. Readable also says the people "live there" for "its inhabitants".

decisions.choice: He aquí
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the old attention word "he aquí" for hinneh, as the published Literal does; Balanced and Readable say "¡Mira!" and "¡Escucha!", as the English.

decisions.choice: "dunia"
decisions.reason: In this poem of judgment on the whole world (chapters 24-27) erets is the earth, so Swahili says "dunia" rather than "nchi", which would read as the land of Judah; "ulimwengu" is kept for tevel, "the world" (verse 4).

decisions.choice: "đất" / "trái đất" for the whole earth
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the earth as the whole world in chapters 24-27, so Vietnamese uses "đất" and "trái đất", not "xứ", which would suggest the land of Judah.

source.text: וְהָיָ֤ה כָעָם֙ כַּכֹּהֵ֔ן כַּעֶ֨בֶד֙ כַּֽאדֹנָ֔יו כַּשִּׁפְחָ֖ה כַּגְּבִרְתָּ֑הּ כַּקּוֹנֶה֙ כַּמּוֹכֵ֔ר כַּמַּלְוֶה֙ כַּלֹּוֶ֔ה כַּנֹּשֶׁ֕ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נֹשֶׁ֥א בֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be as [the] people, as [the] priest; as the servant, as his master; as the maidservant, as her mistress; as the buyer, as the seller; as the lender, as the borrower; as the creditor, as [the one] who a creditor [is] against him.

en.L: And it will be, as [with the] people, so [with the] priest; \q as [with the] servant, so [with] his master; \q as [with the] maidservant, so [with] her mistress; \q as [with the] buyer, so [with the] seller; \q as [with the] lender, so [with the] borrower; \q as [with the] creditor, so [with the one] who [has] a creditor against him.
en.B: It will go the same for people and priest, \q for servant and master, for maid and mistress, \q for buyer and seller, for lender and borrower, \q for the one who collects a debt and the one who owes it.
en.R: Everyone will suffer the same. It will not matter who you are: \q an ordinary person or a priest, a servant or a master, a female servant or the woman she works for, \q someone who buys or someone who sells, someone who lends or someone who borrows, someone who is owed money or someone who owes it.

es.L: Y será, como [con el] pueblo, así [con el] sacerdote; \q como [con el] siervo, así [con] su señor; \q como [con la] criada, así [con] su señora; \q como [con el] comprador, así [con el] vendedor; \q como [con el] que presta, así [con el] que pide prestado; \q como [con el] acreedor, así [con el] que tiene un acreedor contra él.
es.B: Les irá igual al pueblo y al sacerdote, \q al siervo y a su amo, a la criada y a su señora, \q al que compra y al que vende, al que presta y al que pide prestado, \q al que cobra una deuda y al que la debe.
es.R: Todos sufrirán lo mismo. No importará quién sea cada uno: \q gente común o sacerdote, siervo o amo, criada o la mujer para quien trabaja, \q el que compra o el que vende, el que presta o el que pide prestado, el que tiene que cobrar o el que debe.

fr.L: Et il en sera du prêtre comme du peuple, \q du maître comme du serviteur, \q de la maîtresse comme de la servante, \q du vendeur comme de l’acheteur, \q de l’emprunteur comme du prêteur, \q du débiteur comme du créancier.
fr.B: Il en ira de même pour le peuple et le prêtre, \q pour le serviteur et son maître, pour la servante et sa maîtresse, \q pour l’acheteur et le vendeur, pour le prêteur et l’emprunteur, \q pour celui qui réclame une dette et celui qui la doit.
fr.R: Tout le monde subira le même sort. Peu importe qui l’on est : \q simple gens ou prêtre, serviteur ou maître, servante ou maîtresse, \q acheteur ou vendeur, prêteur ou emprunteur, celui à qui l’on doit de l’argent ou celui qui en doit.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, kama [kwa] watu, ndivyo [kwa] kuhani; \q kama [kwa] mtumwa, ndivyo [kwa] bwana wake; \q kama [kwa] mjakazi, ndivyo [kwa] bibi yake; \q kama [kwa] mnunuzi, ndivyo [kwa] muuzaji; \q kama [kwa] mkopeshaji, ndivyo [kwa] mkopaji; \q kama [kwa] mdai, ndivyo [kwa yeye] anayedaiwa.
sw.B: Itakuwa vivyo hivyo kwa watu na kwa kuhani, \q kwa mtumishi na kwa bwana wake, kwa mjakazi na kwa bibi yake, \q kwa mnunuzi na kwa muuzaji, kwa mkopeshaji na kwa mkopaji, \q kwa anayedai deni na kwa anayedaiwa.
sw.R: Kila mtu atateseka vilevile. Haitajalisha wewe ni nani: \q mtu wa kawaida au kuhani, mtumishi au bwana, mtumishi wa kike au mwanamke anayemfanyia kazi, \q anayenunua au anayeuza, anayekopesha au anayekopa, anayedai fedha au anayedaiwa.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra, dân thế nào, thầy tế lễ cũng thế ấy; \q đầy tớ thế nào, chủ nó cũng thế ấy; \q tớ gái thế nào, bà chủ nó cũng thế ấy; \q người mua thế nào, người bán cũng thế ấy; \q người cho vay thế nào, người vay cũng thế ấy; \q chủ nợ thế nào, [người] mắc nợ cũng thế ấy.
vi.B: Dân thường hay thầy tế lễ, \q đầy tớ hay chủ, tớ gái hay bà chủ, \q người mua hay người bán, người cho vay hay người vay, \q chủ nợ hay con nợ, ai cũng chịu chung một số phận.
vi.R: Mọi người sẽ cùng chịu khổ như nhau. Dù là ai cũng vậy: \q người dân thường hay thầy tế lễ, đầy tớ hay ông chủ, tớ gái hay bà chủ, \q người mua hay người bán, người cho vay hay người đi vay, người cho mượn tiền hay người mắc nợ.

decisions.choice: as the people, so the priest: rank and wealth will protect no one
decisions.reason: The list pairs opposite places in society: worship, the household, trade and money. Hosea 4:9 uses the same words, "like people, like priest", for a judgment that falls on all alike.

decisions.choice: the creditor ... the one who has a creditor against him: the lender and the debtor
decisions.reason: The last pair repeats the money theme with a different verb: the one who lends at interest and the one who owes him (Exodus 22:24; Deuteronomy 24:10-11).

decisions.choice: Everyone will suffer the same. It will not matter who you are
decisions.reason: Readable states the point of the list before giving it, since the Hebrew pattern "as ..., as ..." is hard to follow in plain language.

decisions.choice: "il en sera du prêtre comme du peuple"
decisions.reason: French says the comparison "il en sera de X comme de Y" with the second term first; the Literal keeps every pair and the brackets are not needed.

decisions.choice: the pairs listed first, then "ai cũng chịu chung một số phận"
alternatives: "dân thế nào, thầy tế lễ cũng thế ấy"
decisions.reason: Balanced lists the pairs and gives the common fate at the end, which reads naturally in Vietnamese; Literal keeps the Hebrew pattern "as ..., so ...".

source.text: הִבּ֧וֹק׀תִּבּ֛וֹק הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהִבּ֣וֹז׀תִּבּ֑וֹז כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Utterly will be laid waste the earth and utterly will be plundered, for Yahweh has spoken this word.

en.L: Utterly laid waste will the earth be, and utterly plundered, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken this word.
en.B: The earth will be stripped completely bare and looted through and through, \q for this is the word {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken.
en.R: The earth will be completely emptied and robbed of everything. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has said this will happen.

es.L: Del todo vaciada será la tierra, y del todo saqueada, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hablado esta palabra.
es.B: La tierra quedará completamente despojada y saqueada de punta a punta, \q porque esta es la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hablado.
es.R: La tierra quedará vacía por completo y le robarán todo. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha dicho que esto sucederá.

fr.L: Elle sera entièrement dévastée, la terre, et entièrement pillée, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit cette parole.
fr.B: La terre sera complètement dépouillée, pillée de fond en comble, \q car c’est la parole qu’a prononcée {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: La terre sera complètement vidée et on lui volera tout. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit que cela arriverait.

sw.L: Hakika dunia itafanywa tupu kabisa, na kuporwa kabisa, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema neno hili.
sw.B: Dunia itavuliwa kila kitu kabisa na kuporwa kabisa, \q kwa maana hili ndilo neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema.
sw.R: Dunia itafanywa tupu kabisa na kunyang'anywa kila kitu. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema kwamba jambo hili litatokea.

vi.L: Đất sẽ bị vét sạch hoàn toàn, và bị cướp bóc hoàn toàn, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán lời này.
vi.B: Mặt đất sẽ bị vét sạch không còn gì, bị cướp phá tan tành, \q vì đó là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.R: Trái đất sẽ bị vét sạch và bị cướp hết mọi thứ. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán điều này sẽ xảy ra.

decisions.choice: utterly laid waste ... utterly plundered: each verb doubled for emphasis
decisions.reason: Each verb is written twice, an infinitive with the finite verb, which stresses that the emptying and plundering will be complete. The first verb takes up "lay waste" from verse 1.

decisions.choice: Yahweh has spoken this word: the judgment is certain because God has said it
decisions.reason: Isaiah closes words of judgment and promise with this formula (1:20; 40:5; 58:14). What God has spoken will come about.

source.text: אָבְלָ֤ה נָֽבְלָה֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֻמְלְלָ֥ה נָבְלָ֖ה תֵּבֵ֑ל אֻמְלָ֖לוּ מְר֥וֹם עַם־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: It has dried up, it has withered, the earth; it has languished, it has withered, the world; they have languished, the height of the people of the earth.

en.L: The earth has dried up [and] withered; \q the world has wasted away [and] withered; \q the height of the people of the earth have wasted away.
en.B: The earth dries up and wilts; \q the world shrivels and wilts; \q the proudest of the earth's people waste away.
en.R: The earth dries up and wilts away. \q The whole world wilts and grows weak. \q Even the most important people on earth grow weak.

es.L: La tierra se ha secado [y] marchitado; \q el mundo ha desfallecido [y] se ha marchitado; \q han desfallecido los encumbrados del pueblo de la tierra.
es.B: La tierra se seca y se marchita; \q el mundo se consume y se marchita; \q los más altivos del pueblo de la tierra desfallecen.
es.R: La tierra se seca y se marchita. \q Todo el mundo se marchita y se debilita. \q Hasta la gente más importante de la tierra se debilita.

fr.L: La terre s’est desséchée [et] flétrie ; \q le monde a dépéri [et] s’est flétri ; \q les plus élevés du peuple de la terre ont dépéri.
fr.B: La terre se dessèche et se flétrit ; \q le monde s’étiole et se flétrit ; \q les plus fiers des habitants de la terre dépérissent.
fr.R: La terre se dessèche et se fane. \q Le monde entier se fane et s’affaiblit. \q Même les gens les plus importants de la terre s’affaiblissent.

sw.L: Dunia imekauka [na] kunyauka; \q ulimwengu umedhoofika [na] kunyauka; \q walio juu kati ya watu wa dunia wamedhoofika.
sw.B: Dunia inakauka na kunyauka; \q ulimwengu unasinyaa na kunyauka; \q wenye kiburi kuliko wote kati ya watu wa dunia wanadhoofika.
sw.R: Dunia inakauka na kunyauka. \q Ulimwengu wote unanyauka na kudhoofika. \q Hata watu walio muhimu kuliko wote duniani wanadhoofika.

vi.L: Đất đã khô héo [và] tàn úa; \q thế gian đã mòn mỏi [và] tàn úa; \q những bậc cao trọng của dân trên đất đã mòn mỏi.
vi.B: Mặt đất khô cằn và héo hắt; \q thế gian tàn tạ và héo hắt; \q những kẻ kiêu căng nhất trong dân trên đất cũng mòn mỏi.
vi.R: Trái đất khô cằn và héo úa. \q Cả thế giới héo hon và yếu ớt. \q Ngay cả những người quan trọng nhất trên đất cũng suy yếu.

decisions.choice: dried up: the earth dries out (not "mourns")
decisions.reason: The verb has two senses, to mourn and to dry up. Paired with "withered", and with the failing wine and vine of verse 7, the sense of drying fits best here (also Jeremiah 12:4; Amos 1:2). The earth's drying is also a picture of grief.

decisions.choice: the height of the people of the earth: the highest in rank among the earth's people
alternatives: the heavens waste away with the earth
decisions.reason: The received text reads "the height of the people of the earth", the great and the proud (2:12-17). With one vowel changed, the same consonants read "the height with the earth", that is, the sky wastes away along with the earth, which would match heaven and earth in verse 21. The text as it stands makes good sense and is kept.

decisions.choice: the proudest of the earth's people (Balanced); the most important people on earth (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Height" here names people of high rank; Literal keeps "the height".

source.text: וְהָאָ֥רֶץ חָנְפָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ כִּֽי־עָבְר֤וּ תוֹרֹת֙ חָ֣לְפוּ חֹ֔ק הֵפֵ֖רוּ בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And the earth has been polluted under its inhabitants, for they have transgressed laws, they have overstepped [the] decree, they have broken [the] covenant of perpetuity.

en.L: And the earth has been polluted under its inhabitants, \q for they have transgressed instructions, overstepped [the] statute, broken [the] everlasting covenant.
en.B: The earth lies polluted beneath the people who live on it, \q for they have stepped over the instructions, brushed past the decree, and broken the covenant that was to last forever.
en.R: The people of the earth have made it unclean. \q They have disobeyed God's teachings and ignored {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws. They have broken the covenant that was meant to last forever.

es.L: Y la tierra ha sido profanada bajo sus habitantes, \q porque han traspasado las instrucciones, han violado [el] estatuto, han quebrantado [el] pacto eterno.
es.B: La tierra yace contaminada bajo los que viven en ella, \q porque han pasado por encima de las instrucciones, han hecho a un lado el decreto y han roto el pacto que debía durar para siempre.
es.R: La gente de la tierra la ha hecho impura. \q Han desobedecido las enseñanzas de Dios y no han hecho caso de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes. Han roto el pacto que debía durar para siempre.

fr.L: Et la terre a été profanée sous ses habitants, \q car ils ont transgressé les lois, enfreint le décret, rompu l’alliance éternelle.
fr.B: La terre est souillée sous les pas de ceux qui l’habitent, \q car ils ont passé outre aux instructions, contourné le décret et rompu l’alliance qui devait durer toujours.
fr.R: Les habitants de la terre l’ont rendue impure. \q Ils ont désobéi aux enseignements de Dieu et méprisé {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois. Ils ont rompu l’alliance qui devait durer toujours.

sw.L: Na dunia imetiwa unajisi chini ya wakaaji wake, \q kwa maana wamezivunja sheria, wameikiuka kanuni, wamelivunja agano la milele.
sw.B: Dunia imetiwa unajisi chini ya watu wanaoishi juu yake, \q kwa maana wameyakanyaga mafundisho, wameipita kanuni, na kulivunja agano lililokusudiwa kudumu milele.
sw.R: Watu wa dunia wameifanya kuwa najisi. \q Wameyakataa mafundisho ya Mungu na kupuuza sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Wamevunja agano lililokusudiwa kudumu milele.

vi.L: Và đất đã bị ô uế dưới [chân] cư dân nó, \q vì họ đã vi phạm các lời dạy, vượt qua luật lệ, bội giao ước đời đời.
vi.B: Mặt đất bị ô uế dưới chân những người sống trên đó, \q vì họ đã bước qua các lời dạy, gạt bỏ luật lệ, và bội giao ước lẽ ra phải còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Người ta đã làm cho trái đất ra ô uế. \q Họ không vâng theo lời dạy của Đức Chúa Trời và xem thường luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Họ đã phá bỏ giao ước lẽ ra phải còn mãi mãi.

decisions.choice: polluted: made unclean by guilt, above all by bloodshed
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a land defiled by the blood shed on it (Numbers 35:33; Psalm 106:38) and by unfaithfulness (Jeremiah 3:1-2). The earth bears the stain of what its people have done.

decisions.choice: the everlasting covenant: most likely God's covenant with all living things after the flood
alternatives: the covenant made with Israel at Sinai
decisions.reason: Because the whole earth's people are in view, the likeliest reference is the covenant of Genesis 9:16, made with every living creature, whose terms forbid shedding human blood (Genesis 9:5-6). The same phrase is used of the Sabbath at Sinai (Exodus 31:16) and of God's covenant with David (2 Samuel 23:5), so a covenant known to Israel may also be in mind.

decisions.choice: laws ... decree: God's instruction and fixed rulings
decisions.reason: The first word is the plural of torah, instruction; the second is a fixed decree or statute. Together with "covenant" they name all that God had set in place.

decisions.choice: God's teachings ... his laws
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say whose laws these are; they are God's, as the covenant is. Readable says so.

decisions.choice: las instrucciones; el pacto eterno
decisions.reason: Torah is "instrucción" at L and B and "enseñanza" at R, as the Psalms note; the covenant is "pacto", as from Genesis on.

decisions.choice: "sheria" (L); "mafundisho" (B, R)
decisions.reason: God's torah is "sheria" at Literal and "mafundisho" at Balanced and Readable, as the Psalms note and the terms note settle for Swahili; "agano la milele" keeps the word of Genesis 9:16.

decisions.choice: "giao ước đời đời"
decisions.reason: The everlasting covenant, as Genesis 9:16 names God's covenant with every living creature; "đời đời" keeps the wording of the published Genesis verse.

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֗ן אָלָה֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֶ֔רֶץ וַֽיֶּאְשְׁמ֖וּ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ עַל־כֵּ֗ן חָרוּ֙ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי אֶ֔רֶץ וְנִשְׁאַ֥ר אֱנ֖וֹשׁ מִזְעָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore a curse has consumed [the] earth, and they have been held guilty, [the] inhabitants in it; therefore they have been scorched, [the] inhabitants of [the] earth, and is left humankind few.

en.L: Therefore a curse has devoured [the] earth, \q and those who dwell in it bear [their] guilt; \q therefore the inhabitants of [the] earth have been scorched, \q and humankind is left few.
en.B: That is why a curse eats away the earth, \q and those who live on it pay for their guilt. \q That is why the earth's inhabitants are scorched away, \q and only a handful of human beings remain.
en.R: So a curse is destroying the earth. \q The people who live on it are paying for their sins. \q That is why the people of the earth are burned up, and hardly anyone is left alive.

es.L: Por eso una maldición ha devorado [la] tierra, \q y los que habitan en ella llevan [su] culpa; \q por eso los habitantes de [la] tierra han sido abrasados, \q y quedan pocos seres humanos.
es.B: Por eso una maldición devora la tierra, \q y los que viven en ella pagan su culpa. \q Por eso los habitantes de la tierra son consumidos por el fuego, \q y solo queda un puñado de seres humanos.
es.R: Por eso una maldición está destruyendo la tierra. \q La gente que vive en ella está pagando por sus pecados. \q Por eso la gente de la tierra es quemada, y casi nadie queda con vida.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi une malédiction a dévoré la terre, \q et ceux qui l’habitent portent [leur] culpabilité ; \q c’est pourquoi les habitants de la terre ont été consumés, \q et il reste peu d’humains.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi une malédiction ronge la terre, \q et ceux qui l’habitent paient leur faute. \q Voilà pourquoi les habitants de la terre sont brûlés, \q et il ne reste qu’une poignée d’êtres humains.
fr.R: Alors une malédiction détruit la terre. \q Ceux qui y vivent paient pour leurs péchés. \q Voilà pourquoi les habitants de la terre sont brûlés, et il ne reste presque personne en vie.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo laana imeila dunia, \q na wanaokaa ndani yake wanabeba hatia [yao]; \q kwa hiyo wakaaji wa dunia wameunguzwa, \q na wanadamu wamebaki wachache.
sw.B: Ndiyo maana laana inaila dunia, \q na wanaoishi juu yake wanalipia hatia yao. \q Ndiyo maana wakaaji wa dunia wanateketea, \q na ni wanadamu wachache tu wanaobaki.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo laana inaiangamiza dunia. \q Watu wanaoishi juu yake wanalipia dhambi zao. \q Ndiyo sababu watu wa dunia wanateketezwa, na karibu hakuna anayebaki hai.

vi.L: Vì vậy lời rủa sả đã nuốt [đất], \q và những người ở trong đó phải mang [tội của họ]; \q vì vậy cư dân trên [đất] đã bị thiêu đốt, \q và loài người còn lại ít ỏi.
vi.B: Vì thế lời nguyền rủa gặm nhấm mặt đất, \q và những người sống trên đó phải gánh hậu quả tội mình. \q Vì thế cư dân trên đất bị thiêu đốt, \q chỉ còn lại một số ít người.
vi.R: Vì vậy, một lời nguyền rủa đang hủy diệt trái đất. \q Những người sống trên đất đang phải trả giá cho tội lỗi mình. \q Vì vậy dân cư trên đất bị thiêu đốt, chỉ còn rất ít người sống sót.

decisions.choice: a curse has devoured the earth: the penalty that follows a broken covenant
decisions.reason: A curse is the sworn penalty for breaking a covenant (Deuteronomy 28:15-68). In Zechariah 5:3-4 a curse goes out over the whole land and consumes the house of the wrongdoer. Here it follows the broken covenant of verse 5.

decisions.choice: held guilty: they bear their guilt and its penalty
decisions.reason: The verb means to be guilty and to suffer for it (Hosea 5:15; Psalm 34:23).

decisions.choice: scorched: burned
decisions.reason: The verb most likely means to burn, as in Job 30:30 ("my bones burn with heat"). Others take it as "dwindle", which fits the next line about the few left. Either way, few survive.

source.text: אָבַ֥ל תִּיר֖וֹשׁ אֻמְלְלָה־גָ֑פֶן נֶאֶנְח֖וּ כָּל־שִׂמְחֵי־לֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: It has dried up, [the] new wine; it has languished, [the] vine; they have groaned, all [the] glad of heart.

en.L: The new wine has dried up, the vine has wasted away; \q all the glad of heart have groaned.
en.B: The new wine fails, the vine droops, \q and all whose hearts were merry now groan.
en.R: There is no new wine, and the grapevines are dying. \q Everyone who used to be happy is now groaning.

es.L: Se ha secado el mosto, ha desfallecido la vid; \q han gemido todos los alegres de corazón.
es.B: Falta el mosto, la vid languidece, \q y todos los de corazón alegre ahora gimen.
es.R: No hay vino nuevo, y las vides se están muriendo. \q Todos los que antes estaban contentos ahora gimen.

fr.L: Le vin nouveau s’est desséché, la vigne a dépéri ; \q tous ceux qui avaient le cœur joyeux ont gémi.
fr.B: Le vin nouveau manque, la vigne languit, \q et tous ceux qui avaient le cœur en fête gémissent.
fr.R: Il n’y a plus de vin nouveau, et les vignes meurent. \q Tous ceux qui étaient heureux gémissent maintenant.

sw.L: Divai mpya imekauka, mzabibu umedhoofika; \q wote wenye moyo wa furaha wameugua.
sw.B: Divai mpya inakwisha, mzabibu unanyauka, \q na wote waliokuwa na mioyo yenye furaha sasa wanaugua.
sw.R: Hakuna divai mpya, na mizabibu inakufa. \q Kila mtu aliyekuwa na furaha sasa analalamika kwa uchungu.

vi.L: Rượu mới đã khô cạn, cây nho đã tàn héo; \q mọi kẻ có lòng vui vẻ đã than thở.
vi.B: Rượu mới cạn khô, cây nho héo úa, \q và mọi người từng vui lòng nay đều rên xiết.
vi.R: Không còn rượu mới, các cây nho đang chết dần. \q Ai từng vui vẻ nay đều than thở.

decisions.choice: new wine: the fresh juice of the grape
decisions.reason: The word names the new wine of the harvest, a sign of God's blessing (Deuteronomy 7:13; Hosea 2:10). The same two verbs as verse 4 now strike the vine.

decisions.choice: the glad of heart: those who celebrated with wine
decisions.reason: The grape harvest was a time of song and feasting (16:10; Judges 9:27). Verses 7-12 picture that joy ending.

source.text: שָׁבַת֙ מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ תֻּפִּ֔ים חָדַ֖ל שְׁא֣וֹן עַלִּיזִ֑ים שָׁבַ֖ת מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ כִּנּֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: It has ceased, [the] joy of tambourines; it has stopped, [the] uproar of exultant [ones]; it has ceased, [the] joy of [the] lyre.

en.L: The joy of tambourines has ceased, \q the uproar of the exultant has stopped, \q the joy of the lyre has ceased.
en.B: The merry beat of the tambourines is over, \q the din of the revelers has stopped, \q the gladness of the lyre is over.
en.R: No one plays happy music on tambourines or harps anymore. \q The noisy parties have come to an end.

es.L: Ha cesado la alegría de los panderos, \q se ha acabado el bullicio de los que se divierten, \q ha cesado la alegría de la lira.
es.B: Se acabó el alegre son de los panderos, \q se ha callado el estruendo de los juerguistas, \q se acabó la alegría de la lira.
es.R: Ya nadie toca música alegre con panderos ni con arpas. \q Las fiestas ruidosas se han terminado.

fr.L: La joie des tambourins a cessé, \q le vacarme des gens en liesse a pris fin, \q la joie de la lyre a cessé.
fr.B: Le rythme joyeux des tambourins s’est tu, \q le tapage des fêtards s’est arrêté, \q l’allégresse de la lyre s’est tue.
fr.R: Personne ne joue plus de musique joyeuse sur les tambourins et les harpes. \q Les fêtes bruyantes sont finies.

sw.L: Furaha ya matari imekoma, \q makelele ya wanaoshangilia yamesimama, \q furaha ya kinubi imekoma.
sw.B: Mdundo wa furaha wa matari umekwisha, \q kelele za wanaosherehekea zimesimama, \q furaha ya kinubi imekwisha.
sw.R: Hakuna tena anayepiga muziki wa furaha kwa matari au vinubi. \q Sherehe za kelele zimekwisha.

vi.L: Niềm vui của trống cơm đã ngưng, \q tiếng ồn ào của kẻ vui reo đã dứt, \q niềm vui của đàn lia đã ngưng.
vi.B: Tiếng trống cơm rộn ràng đã tắt, \q tiếng huyên náo của kẻ vui chơi đã dứt, \q tiếng đàn lia vui tươi đã ngưng.
vi.R: Không còn ai chơi những điệu nhạc vui trên trống cơm hay đàn hạc nữa. \q Những cuộc vui ồn ào đã chấm dứt.

decisions.choice: tambourines and lyre: the music of feasts
decisions.reason: Hand drums and the lyre went with celebrations and banquets (5:12; Genesis 31:27). Their silence means the feasting is over.

decisions.choice: the uproar of the exultant: the noise of revelers
decisions.reason: The same words describe the revelers of Jerusalem going down to the grave in 5:14.

decisions.choice: puts the tambourines and harps together, then the parties; "harps" for the lyre
decisions.reason: Readable joins the two lines about instruments into one sentence and uses the more familiar word "harp" for this stringed instrument.

source.text: בַּשִּׁ֖יר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתּוּ־יָ֑יִן יֵמַ֥ר שֵׁכָ֖ר לְשֹׁתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: With song not they drink wine; it is bitter, strong drink, to those who drink it.

en.L: With song they do not drink wine; \q strong drink is bitter to those who drink it.
en.B: They no longer drink their wine to the sound of song; \q beer turns bitter in the drinker's mouth.
en.R: People no longer sing while they drink wine. \q Beer tastes bitter to them.

es.L: Con canto no beben vino; \q amarga es la bebida fuerte para los que la beben.
es.B: Ya no beben su vino al son de canciones; \q la cerveza se vuelve amarga en la boca del que la bebe.
es.R: La gente ya no canta mientras bebe vino. \q La cerveza les sabe amarga.

fr.L: Avec des chants, ils ne boivent plus de vin ; \q la boisson forte est amère à ceux qui la boivent.
fr.B: On ne boit plus le vin au son des chants ; \q la bière devient amère dans la bouche des buveurs.
fr.R: Les gens ne chantent plus en buvant du vin. \q La bière a pour eux un goût amer.

sw.L: Kwa wimbo hawanywi divai; \q kileo ni kichungu kwa wale wanaokinywa.
sw.B: Hawanywi tena divai yao huku wakiimba; \q pombe inakuwa chungu kinywani mwa anayeinywa.
sw.R: Watu hawaimbi tena wanapokunywa divai. \q Pombe ina ladha chungu kwao.

vi.L: Họ không uống rượu với bài ca; \q rượu mạnh trở nên đắng cho kẻ uống nó.
vi.B: Họ không còn vừa uống rượu vừa ca hát; \q rượu mạnh trở nên đắng trong miệng kẻ uống.
vi.R: Người ta không còn ca hát khi uống rượu. \q Rượu mạnh trở nên đắng đối với họ.

decisions.choice: strong drink: beer or other brewed drink
decisions.reason: The word names an intoxicating drink other than wine, made from grain or fruit (5:11, 22; 28:7).

decisions.choice: is bitter: has lost all pleasure
decisions.reason: What once gave pleasure now tastes bitter; the drinking goes on without joy (compare 5:11-12).

source.text: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה קִרְיַת־תֹּ֑הוּ סֻגַּ֥ר כָּל־בַּ֖יִת מִבּֽוֹא׃

records.literal_gloss: It has been broken, [the] town of formlessness; it has been shut up, every house, from entering.

en.L: The town of emptiness has been broken; \q every house has been shut up from entering.
en.B: The town of chaos is smashed; \q every house is shut, and no one can get in.
en.R: The city of chaos is broken down. \q Every house is locked so that no one can get in.

es.L: Ha sido quebrantada la ciudad del caos; \q toda casa ha sido cerrada para que no se entre.
es.B: La ciudad del caos está hecha pedazos; \q toda casa está cerrada, y nadie puede entrar.
es.R: La ciudad del caos está destruida. \q Todas las casas están cerradas para que nadie pueda entrar.

fr.L: Elle est brisée, la ville du chaos ; \q toute maison est fermée, on ne peut plus y entrer.
fr.B: La ville du chaos est fracassée ; \q chaque maison est close, et personne ne peut y entrer.
fr.R: La ville du désordre est démolie. \q Toutes les maisons sont fermées à clé, et personne ne peut y entrer.

sw.L: Mji wa utupu umevunjwa; \q kila nyumba imefungwa isiingiwe.
sw.B: Mji wa machafuko umevunjwa vipande vipande; \q kila nyumba imefungwa, wala hakuna anayeweza kuingia.
sw.R: Mji wa machafuko umebomolewa. \q Kila nyumba imefungwa ili mtu yeyote asiingie.

vi.L: Thành hỗn mang đã bị phá vỡ; \q mọi nhà đều bị đóng lại, không vào được.
vi.B: Thành hỗn loạn đã bị đập tan; \q mọi nhà đều đóng kín, không ai vào được.
vi.R: Thành phố hỗn loạn đã bị phá đổ. \q Mọi nhà đều khóa cửa, không ai vào được.

decisions.choice: town of formlessness: a city reduced to chaos, like the earth before creation
decisions.reason: The word is the one used of the earth "formless" before God ordered it (Genesis 1:2; Jeremiah 4:23). The city falls back into chaos and emptiness.

decisions.choice: the town: not named, perhaps standing for every city set against God
decisions.reason: The city is not named here or in 25:2, 26:5 and 27:10. It may be one city, such as Babylon or Jerusalem, or a picture of human society in its pride.

decisions.choice: shut up from entering: no one can go in
decisions.reason: The houses are either barred against attackers or left empty, so that no one enters. Both lead to the same picture of a dead city.

decisions.choice: "hỗn mang" (L); "hỗn loạn" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is the "formless" of Genesis 1:2; Literal uses "hỗn mang", which recalls the chaos before creation, and Balanced and Readable say "hỗn loạn".

source.text: צְוָחָ֥ה עַל־הַיַּ֖יִן בַּֽחוּצ֑וֹת עָֽרְבָה֙ כָּל־שִׂמְחָ֔ה גָּלָ֖ה מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: An outcry over the wine in the streets; it has grown dark, all gladness; it has gone into exile, the joy of the earth.

en.L: An outcry over the wine [is] in the streets; \q all gladness has grown dark; \q the joy of the earth has gone into exile.
en.B: In the streets there is crying out over the wine; \q all gladness has darkened into evening; \q the joy of the earth has been carried off into exile.
en.R: People in the streets cry out because there is no wine. \q All happiness has faded away like the light at sunset. \q Joy has been taken away from the earth.

es.L: Un clamor por el vino [hay] en las calles; \q se ha oscurecido toda alegría; \q ha ido al destierro el gozo de la tierra.
es.B: En las calles se oyen gritos por el vino; \q toda alegría se ha apagado como al anochecer; \q el gozo de la tierra ha sido llevado al destierro.
es.R: La gente grita en las calles porque no hay vino. \q Toda la felicidad se ha apagado como la luz al atardecer. \q La alegría ha sido quitada de la tierra.

fr.L: Une clameur au sujet du vin [s’élève] dans les rues ; \q toute joie s’est assombrie ; \q l’allégresse de la terre est partie en exil.
fr.B: Dans les rues, on crie à cause du vin ; \q toute joie a sombré dans le soir ; \q l’allégresse de la terre a été emmenée en exil.
fr.R: Dans les rues, les gens crient parce qu’il n’y a plus de vin. \q Tout le bonheur s’est éteint, comme la lumière au coucher du soleil. \q La joie a été enlevée de la terre.

sw.L: Kilio juu ya divai [kiko] barabarani; \q furaha yote imetiwa giza; \q shangwe ya dunia imekwenda uhamishoni.
sw.B: Barabarani kuna kilio kwa ajili ya divai; \q furaha yote imegeuka giza la jioni; \q shangwe ya dunia imechukuliwa uhamishoni.
sw.R: Watu barabarani wanalia kwa sababu hakuna divai. \q Furaha yote imefifia kama mwanga wakati wa machweo. \q Shangwe imeondolewa duniani.

vi.L: Tiếng kêu la về rượu [vang lên] ngoài đường phố; \q mọi niềm vui đã trở nên u tối; \q sự hân hoan của đất đã bị lưu đày.
vi.B: Ngoài phố vang tiếng kêu la vì rượu; \q mọi niềm vui đã tắt như ánh chiều tà; \q sự hân hoan của đất đã bị bắt đi lưu đày.
vi.R: Ngoài đường phố người ta kêu la vì không còn rượu. \q Mọi niềm vui đã phai tàn như ánh sáng lúc mặt trời lặn. \q Niềm vui đã bị cất khỏi trái đất.

decisions.choice: grown dark: gladness has set like the sun
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word for evening: joy has gone down like the light at the end of the day.

decisions.choice: gone into exile: carried away
decisions.reason: The verb is the usual one for a people taken away captive (5:13). Joy itself is pictured as deported from the earth.

decisions.choice: because there is no wine
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "over the wine". In the light of verses 7 and 9 the cry is for wine that has failed; Readable says so.

source.text: נִשְׁאַ֥ר בָּעִ֖יר שַׁמָּ֑ה וּשְׁאִיָּ֖ה יֻכַּת־שָֽׁעַר׃

records.literal_gloss: It has remained in [the] city desolation, and [into] ruin it has been crushed, [the] gate.

en.L: Desolation is left in the city, \q and [the] gate is crushed [to] ruin.
en.B: Only desolation is left in the city, \q and the gate is smashed to rubble.
en.R: Only ruins are left in the city. \q Its gate has been smashed to pieces.

es.L: Ha quedado en la ciudad la desolación, \q y [en] ruina ha sido derribada [la] puerta.
es.B: Solo la desolación ha quedado en la ciudad, \q y la puerta está hecha escombros.
es.R: Solo quedan ruinas en la ciudad. \q Su puerta ha sido hecha pedazos.

fr.L: La désolation est restée dans la ville, \q et la porte est écrasée en ruine.
fr.B: Il ne reste que la désolation dans la ville, \q et la porte est réduite en décombres.
fr.R: Il ne reste que des ruines dans la ville. \q Sa porte a été mise en pièces.

sw.L: Ukiwa umebaki mjini, \q na lango limepondwa [kuwa] magofu.
sw.B: Ni ukiwa tu uliobaki mjini, \q na lango limevunjwa kuwa kifusi.
sw.R: Ni magofu tu yaliyobaki mjini. \q Lango lake limevunjwa vipande vipande.

vi.L: Sự hoang tàn còn lại trong thành, \q và cổng thành bị đập [thành] đống vụn.
vi.B: Trong thành chỉ còn lại cảnh hoang tàn, \q và cổng thành bị đập nát thành đống gạch vụn.
vi.R: Trong thành chỉ còn lại những đống đổ nát. \q Cổng thành đã bị đập tan tành.

decisions.choice: ruin: a crash, a heap of rubble
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here. It is related to words for a crash or din and for devastation (6:11).

decisions.choice: the gate: the city's defense and meeting place
decisions.reason: The gate was the strongest point of a city wall and the place of trade and judgment. A broken gate means a city that cannot defend itself.

source.text: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה יִהְיֶ֛ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָֽעַמִּ֑ים כְּנֹ֣קֶף זַ֔יִת כְּעוֹלֵלֹ֖ת אִם־כָּלָ֥ה בָצִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus it will be in [the] midst of the earth, among the peoples: like [the] beating of an olive tree, like gleanings when it has ended, [the] grape harvest.

en.L: For thus it will be in the midst of the earth, among the peoples, \q like the beating of an olive tree, \q like gleanings when the grape harvest has ended.
en.B: For this is how it will be in the heart of the earth, among the peoples: \q like an olive tree after it has been beaten, \q like the last grapes picked once the harvest is over.
en.R: This is what will happen to the peoples all over the earth. \q They will be like an olive tree after its olives have been knocked down, with only a few left on it. \q They will be like a vine after the grapes have been picked, with only a few grapes left.

es.L: Porque así será en medio de la tierra, entre los pueblos, \q como el vareo del olivo, \q como los rebuscos cuando se ha acabado la vendimia.
es.B: Porque así será en el corazón de la tierra, entre los pueblos: \q como un olivo después de haber sido vareado, \q como las últimas uvas que se recogen cuando la vendimia ha terminado.
es.R: Esto es lo que les pasará a los pueblos de toda la tierra. \q Serán como un olivo después de que han tumbado sus aceitunas a golpes, y quedan solo unas pocas. \q Serán como una vid después de la vendimia, cuando solo quedan unas pocas uvas.

fr.L: Car ainsi en sera-t-il au milieu de la terre, parmi les peuples : \q comme quand on bat l’olivier, \q comme les grappillages quand la vendange est finie.
fr.B: Car voici ce qui arrivera au cœur de la terre, parmi les peuples : \q comme un olivier après qu’on l’a battu, \q comme les derniers raisins qu’on cueille une fois la vendange terminée.
fr.R: Voici ce qui arrivera aux peuples de toute la terre. \q Ils seront comme un olivier dont on a fait tomber les olives à coups de bâton, et où il n’en reste que quelques-unes. \q Ils seront comme une vigne après la cueillette, où il ne reste que quelques grappes.

sw.L: Kwa maana ndivyo itakavyokuwa katikati ya dunia, kati ya mataifa, \q kama kupigwa kwa mzeituni, \q kama masazo baada ya mavuno ya zabibu kwisha.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo itakavyokuwa katikati ya dunia, kati ya mataifa: \q kama mzeituni baada ya kupigwa, \q kama zabibu za mwisho zinazookotwa mavuno yakiisha.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo itakavyowapata watu wa mataifa yote duniani. \q Watakuwa kama mzeituni baada ya zeituni zake kuangushwa, zikabaki chache tu juu yake. \q Watakuwa kama mzabibu baada ya zabibu kuchumwa, zikabaki zabibu chache tu.

vi.L: Vì sẽ như vậy giữa đất, giữa các dân tộc, \q như khi đập cây ô-liu, \q như những trái mót còn lại khi mùa hái nho đã xong.
vi.B: Vì đây là điều sẽ xảy ra giữa lòng đất, giữa các dân tộc: \q như cây ô-liu sau khi đã bị đập trái, \q như những chùm nho mót lại khi mùa hái nho đã xong.
vi.R: Đây là điều sẽ xảy ra cho các dân tộc khắp trên đất. \q Họ sẽ giống như cây ô-liu sau khi người ta đã đập rụng trái, chỉ còn sót lại vài trái trên cây. \q Họ sẽ giống như cây nho sau khi đã hái hết trái, chỉ còn sót lại vài chùm.

decisions.choice: like the beating of an olive tree, like gleanings: only a few will be left
decisions.reason: Olives were knocked from the tree with sticks, and a few were left for the poor to glean (Deuteronomy 24:20-21). Isaiah 17:6 uses the same picture for the few left in Israel. A small remnant survives the judgment.

decisions.choice: with only a few left on it; with only a few grapes left
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the point of the harvest pictures, which a modern reader may not know.

source.text: הֵ֛מָּה יִשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם יָרֹ֑נּוּ בִּגְא֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה צָהֲל֖וּ מִיָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: They will lift up their voice, they will shout for joy; over the majesty of Yahweh they cry aloud from [the] sea.

en.L: They lift up their voice, they shout for joy; \q over the majesty of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} they cry aloud from the sea.
en.B: These raise their voices and ring out with joy; \q from the west they shout aloud at the majesty of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: But the people who are left will shout and sing for joy. \q From the west they will praise how great {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is.

es.L: Ellos alzan su voz, gritan de júbilo; \q por la majestad {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} claman desde el mar.
es.B: Ellos alzan la voz y gritan de alegría; \q desde el occidente aclaman la majestad {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Pero los que queden gritarán y cantarán de alegría. \q Desde el occidente alabarán la grandeza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Eux élèvent leur voix, ils poussent des cris de joie ; \q pour la majesté {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, ils crient fort depuis la mer.
fr.B: Ceux-là élèvent la voix et éclatent de joie ; \q depuis l’occident, ils acclament la majesté {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Mais ceux qui resteront crieront et chanteront de joie. \q Depuis l’ouest, ils diront combien {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand.

sw.L: Wao wanainua sauti yao, wanapiga kelele za furaha; \q juu ya ukuu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wanapaza sauti kutoka baharini.
sw.B: Hao wanapaza sauti zao na kuimba kwa furaha; \q kutoka magharibi wanapiga kelele kwa ajili ya ukuu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lakini watu waliobaki watapiga kelele na kuimba kwa furaha. \q Kutoka magharibi watasifu jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyo mkuu.

vi.L: Họ cất tiếng lên, họ reo hò vui mừng; \q về sự uy nghiêm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, họ kêu lớn từ biển.
vi.B: Những người ấy cất tiếng reo hò vui mừng; \q từ phương tây họ tung hô sự uy nghiêm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Nhưng những người còn sống sót sẽ reo hò và ca hát vui mừng. \q Từ phương tây, họ sẽ ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vĩ đại biết bao.

decisions.choice: they: the few left after the judgment (verse 13)
decisions.reason: The pronoun is stressed: these, in contrast to the earth's lost joy (verses 7-11). It most likely refers to the survivors of verse 13; it may also mean the far peoples whose songs are heard in verse 16.

decisions.choice: from the sea: from the west
decisions.reason: For Israel the sea, the Mediterranean, lies to the west. Verse 15 answers with the east. The same words could mean "louder than the sea", but the pairing with east favors a direction.

decisions.choice: from the west
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the direction meant; Literal keeps "from the sea". Readable also names the survivors (see m1).

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֥ן בָּאֻרִ֖ים כַּבְּד֣וּ יְהוָ֑ה בְּאִיֵּ֣י הַיָּ֔ם שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Therefore in the east glorify Yahweh; in [the] coastlands of the sea [glorify] the name of Yahweh, [the] God of Israel.

en.L: Therefore in the east glorify {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q in the coastlands of the sea [glorify] the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, [the] God of Israel.
en.B: So honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the lands of the dawn; \q in the coastlands of the sea, honor the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.R: So people in the east should honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q People in lands far away across the sea should honor the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.

es.L: Por eso, en el oriente {{plural_you:glorifiquen|glorificad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; \q en las costas del mar, [{{plural_you:glorifiquen|glorificad}}] el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, [el] Dios de Israel.
es.B: Por eso {{plural_you:honren|honrad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en las tierras del alba; \q en las costas lejanas del mar, {{plural_you:honren|honrad}} el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel.
es.R: Por eso, que la gente del oriente honre {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. \q Que la gente de las tierras lejanas, al otro lado del mar, honre el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, dans les régions de la lumière, glorifiez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q dans les îles de la mer, [glorifiez] le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: Rendez donc gloire {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} dans les pays de l’aurore ; \q dans les îles lointaines de la mer, rendez gloire au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: Alors, que les gens de l’est honorent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Que les gens des pays lointains, de l’autre côté de la mer, honorent le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo mashariki mtukuzeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q katika visiwa vya bahari [litukuzeni] jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo mheshimuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika nchi za mapambazuko; \q katika pwani za mbali za bahari, liheshimuni jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo watu wa mashariki wanapaswa kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Watu wa nchi za mbali ng'ambo ya bahari wanapaswa kuliheshimu jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.

vi.L: Vì vậy, ở phương đông hãy tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q tại các hải đảo của biển, [hãy tôn vinh] danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vậy hãy tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại các miền rạng đông; \q tại các hải đảo của biển, hãy tôn kính danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vậy người ở phương đông hãy tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Người ở những miền xa bên kia biển hãy tôn kính danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

decisions.choice: in the east: in the regions of light, where the sun rises
decisions.reason: The word means "lights" or "fires" (31:9; 44:16). Set against the coastlands of the sea, the far west, it most likely names the east, where the light dawns. The word is unusual in this sense, and its meaning is not certain.

decisions.choice: the coastlands of the sea: the shores and islands of the far west
decisions.reason: The word names the coasts and islands of the Mediterranean, the far edge of the known world (11:11; 42:4, 10).

decisions.choice: honor (Balanced, Readable); glorify (Literal)
decisions.reason: The verb means to give weight or honor. Readable says "lands far away" for the coastlands and makes the people in the east the subject.

decisions.choice: las costas (L); las costas lejanas (B); las tierras lejanas (R)
decisions.reason: The block's forms for iyyim, as the terms note and Psalms 72:10 and 97:1.

decisions.choice: "visiwa" (L); "pwani za mbali" (B); "nchi za mbali ng'ambo ya bahari" (R)
decisions.reason: The coastlands (iyyim) are worded this way at each level throughout this block, as the terms note settles from Psalm 97:1 and 72:10.

decisions.choice: "les îles" (L), "les îles lointaines" (B), "les pays lointains" (R) for iyyim, for Isaiah 21-40
decisions.reason: As the terms note and Psalms 97:1 and 72:10.

decisions.choice: "các hải đảo" (L, B); "những miền xa bên kia biển" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for iyyim, as Psalm 72:10 and 97:1; used unchanged through these chapters.

source.text: מִכְּנַ֨ף הָאָ֜רֶץ זְמִרֹ֤ת שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ֙ צְבִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֔יק וָאֹמַ֛ר רָזִי־לִ֥י רָֽזִי־לִ֖י א֣וֹי לִ֑י בֹּגְדִ֣ים בָּגָ֔דוּ וּבֶ֥גֶד בּוֹגְדִ֖ים בָּגָֽדוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] wing of the earth songs we have heard: splendor to the righteous [one]. And I said, leanness to me, leanness to me; woe to me; treacherous [ones] have dealt treacherously, and [with] treachery treacherous [ones] have dealt treacherously.

en.L: From the wing of the earth we have heard songs: "Splendor to the righteous one!" \q And I said, "Leanness to me, leanness to me! Woe to me! \q [The] treacherous have dealt treacherously, \q and [with] treachery [the] treacherous have dealt treacherously."
en.B: From the edge of the earth we have heard songs: "Splendor belongs to the righteous one!" \q But I said, "I am wasting away, wasting away! Woe to me! \q The faithless keep breaking faith; \q with faithless deeds the faithless break faith."
en.R: We have heard songs from the farthest parts of the earth: "Splendor belongs to the one who is righteous!" \q But I said, "I am wasting away! I am wasting away! How terrible it is for me! \q People who cannot be trusted keep betraying others. \q They betray and betray again."

es.L: Desde el extremo de la tierra hemos oído cánticos: «¡Gloria al justo!». \q Pero yo dije: «¡Me consumo, me consumo! ¡Ay de mí! \q Los traidores han traicionado, \q y [con] traición los traidores han traicionado».
es.B: Desde el confín de la tierra hemos oído cánticos: «¡El esplendor es para el justo!». \q Pero yo dije: «¡Me estoy consumiendo, me consumo! ¡Ay de mí! \q Los traidores siguen traicionando; \q con traiciones traicionan los traidores».
es.R: Hemos oído cánticos desde los lugares más lejanos de la tierra: «¡El esplendor es para el que es justo!». \q Pero yo dije: «¡Me estoy consumiendo! ¡Me estoy consumiendo! ¡Qué terrible es esto para mí! \q La gente en quien no se puede confiar sigue traicionando a otros. \q Traicionan una y otra vez».

fr.L: De l’extrémité de la terre nous avons entendu des chants : « Splendeur au juste ! » \q Et j’ai dit : « Maigreur pour moi, maigreur pour moi ! Malheur à moi ! \q Les traîtres ont trahi, \q et de trahison les traîtres ont trahi. »
fr.B: Du bout de la terre nous avons entendu des chants : « La splendeur appartient au juste ! » \q Mais moi, j’ai dit : « Je dépéris, je dépéris ! Malheur à moi ! \q Les perfides ne cessent de trahir ; \q par leurs perfidies les perfides trahissent. »
fr.R: Nous avons entendu des chants venant des endroits les plus lointains de la terre : « La splendeur appartient à celui qui est juste ! » \q Mais moi, j’ai dit : « Je dépéris ! Je dépéris ! Quel malheur pour moi ! \q Ceux à qui on ne peut pas se fier continuent à trahir les autres. \q Ils trahissent et trahissent encore. »

sw.L: Kutoka pembe ya dunia tumesikia nyimbo: "Fahari kwa mwenye haki!" \q Nami nikasema, "Nimekonda, nimekonda! Ole wangu! \q Wadanganyifu wamefanya udanganyifu, \q na [kwa] udanganyifu wadanganyifu wamefanya udanganyifu."
sw.B: Kutoka mwisho wa dunia tumesikia nyimbo: "Fahari ni ya mwenye haki!" \q Lakini mimi nilisema, "Ninadhoofika, ninadhoofika! Ole wangu! \q Wasio waaminifu wanaendelea kusaliti; \q kwa matendo ya usaliti wasio waaminifu wanasaliti."
sw.R: Tumesikia nyimbo kutoka sehemu za mbali kabisa za dunia: "Fahari ni ya yule aliye mwenye haki!" \q Lakini mimi nilisema, "Ninadhoofika! Ninadhoofika! Mambo ni mabaya sana kwangu! \q Watu wasioaminika wanaendelea kuwasaliti wengine. \q Wanasaliti na kusaliti tena."

vi.L: Từ cánh của đất, chúng tôi đã nghe những bài ca: "Vinh hiển cho Đấng công chính!" \q Nhưng tôi nói: "Tôi gầy mòn, tôi gầy mòn! Khốn cho tôi! \q Kẻ phản bội đã phản bội, \q và [bằng] sự phản bội, kẻ phản bội đã phản bội."
vi.B: Từ tận cùng mặt đất, chúng tôi đã nghe những bài ca: "Vinh hiển thuộc về Đấng công chính!" \q Nhưng tôi nói: "Tôi hao mòn, tôi hao mòn! Khốn cho tôi! \q Kẻ bội tín cứ bội tín; \q kẻ bội tín cứ làm điều bội tín."
vi.R: Chúng tôi đã nghe những bài ca từ những nơi xa nhất trên đất: "Vinh hiển thuộc về Đấng công chính!" \q Nhưng tôi nói: "Tôi hao mòn! Tôi hao mòn! Thật khốn khổ cho tôi! \q Những kẻ không đáng tin cứ phản bội người khác. \q Họ phản bội hết lần này đến lần khác."

decisions.choice: the righteous one: left open, either God or the righteous people
decisions.reason: The word is singular. It may name God, the righteous one (Deuteronomy 32:4; 45:21), or the righteous nation that God vindicates (26:2, 7). The song is praise either way.

decisions.choice: leanness to me: I am wasting away
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here. It most likely comes from the root for being lean or thin (10:16; 17:4): the prophet is worn out with grief. The old Latin version (the Vulgate) read it as the Aramaic word for "secret" (Daniel 2:18), "my secret is my own". While others sing, the prophet sees that betrayal and judgment are not over.

decisions.choice: the treacherous deal treacherously: betrayal on every side
decisions.reason: One root is used five times for emphasis. The same phrase describes destroyers in 21:2 and 33:1. Those who break faith are still at work.

decisions.choice: edge of the earth; the faithless break faith (Balanced); betray (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the wing of the earth", meaning its edge (11:12), which Literal keeps. Balanced keeps the repeated root with "faithless ... faith"; Readable uses plain words.

decisions.choice: How terrible it is for me!
decisions.reason: A cry of grief; Readable uses a plain phrase for "woe".

decisions.choice: ¡Ay de mí! (L, B); ¡Qué terrible es esto para mí! (R)
decisions.reason: The block's forms of "woe" said of oneself, as the terms note.

decisions.choice: el extremo de la tierra
decisions.reason: Literal says "extremo" for the Hebrew "wing", since "el ala de la tierra" would not be understood; the English L keeps "wing".

decisions.choice: "Ole wangu" (L, B); "Mambo ni mabaya sana kwangu" (R)
decisions.reason: Woe said of oneself keeps "Ole wangu" of 1 Kings 13:30 at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says it plainly, as the terms note settles.

decisions.choice: "Malheur à moi" (L, B), "Quel malheur pour moi !" (R), said of oneself, for Isaiah 21-40
decisions.reason: As the terms note; the same form as "Malheur à ..." for hoy keeps the link between the two cries.

decisions.choice: "Đấng công chính"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves open whether the righteous one is God or the righteous people; Vietnamese must choose a noun, and "Đấng" follows the reading that it is God, which a reviewer may change to "người công chính".

decisions.choice: "Khốn cho tôi" (L, B); "Thật khốn khổ cho tôi" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for woe said of oneself, as Isaiah 6:5.

source.text: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֖יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Dread and pit and snare [are] upon you, inhabitant of the earth.

en.L: Terror and pit and snare \q [are] upon you, inhabitant of the earth!
en.B: Fear and the pit and the trap \q are upon you who live on the earth!
en.R: All of you who live on the earth, \q terror, a deep pit, and a trap are waiting for you!

es.L: Terror y fosa y trampa \q [hay] sobre ti, habitante de la tierra.
es.B: ¡El terror, la fosa y la trampa \q te esperan a ti, que habitas en la tierra!
es.R: Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que {{plural_you:viven|vivís}} en la tierra, \q ¡el terror, una fosa profunda y una trampa {{plural_you:los esperan|os esperan}}!

fr.L: La terreur, la fosse et le piège \q [sont] sur toi, habitant de la terre !
fr.B: L’épouvante, la fosse et le filet \q sont sur toi qui habites la terre !
fr.R: Vous tous qui habitez sur la terre, \q la terreur, une fosse profonde et un piège vous attendent !

sw.L: Hofu na shimo na mtego \q [viko] juu yako, ewe mkaaji wa dunia!
sw.B: Hofu na shimo na mtego \q viko juu yenu mnaoishi duniani!
sw.R: Enyi nyote mnaoishi duniani, \q hofu kuu, shimo refu na mtego vinawangojea!

vi.L: Kinh hoàng, hố sâu và cạm bẫy \q [ở] trên ngươi, hỡi cư dân trên đất!
vi.B: Nỗi kinh hoàng, hố sâu và cạm bẫy \q đang chờ ngươi, hỡi kẻ sống trên đất!
vi.R: Hỡi tất cả những người sống trên đất, \q nỗi kinh hoàng, hố sâu và cạm bẫy đang chờ các ngươi!

decisions.choice: dread, pit and snare: three sound-alike words for inescapable danger
decisions.reason: The three words sound almost the same in Hebrew, so the line rings like a warning bell. Jeremiah 48:43-44 repeats verses 17-18 against Moab.

decisions.choice: inhabitant of the earth: everyone who lives on the earth
decisions.reason: The word is singular but means all the earth's people, addressed together.

decisions.choice: "la terreur, la fosse et le piège" (L), "l'épouvante, la fosse et le filet" (B)
alternatives: a French sound play such as "la frayeur, la fosse, le filet"
decisions.reason: The three Hebrew words sound alike (paḥad, paḥat, paḥ); Balanced echoes it lightly with "fosse ... filet", without bending the sense.

source.text: וְֽ֠הָיָה הַנָּ֞ס מִקּ֤וֹל הַפַּ֨חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעוֹלֶה֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־אֲרֻבּ֤וֹת מִמָּרוֹם֙ נִפְתָּ֔חוּ וַֽיִּרְעֲשׁ֖וּ מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be: the [one who] flees from the sound of the dread will fall into the pit, and the [one who] goes up from the midst of the pit will be caught in the snare; for windows from [the] height have been opened, and they have shaken, [the] foundations of [the] earth.

en.L: And it will be [that] the one fleeing from the sound of the terror will fall into the pit, \q and the one coming up from the midst of the pit will be caught in the snare; \q for windows from on high have been opened, \q and [the] foundations of [the] earth have shaken.
en.B: Anyone who runs from the sound of fear will drop into the pit, \q and anyone who climbs up out of the pit will be caught in the trap. \q For the windows on high have been thrown open, \q and the foundations of the earth quake.
en.R: Anyone who runs away from the sounds of terror will fall into the pit. \q Anyone who climbs out of the pit will be caught in the trap. \q Windows in the sky have opened to pour down water, \q and the earth shakes down to its foundations.

es.L: Y sucederá [que] el que huya del ruido del terror caerá en la fosa, \q y el que suba de en medio de la fosa quedará atrapado en la trampa; \q porque las ventanas de lo alto se han abierto, \q y se han estremecido [los] cimientos de [la] tierra.
es.B: El que huya del ruido del terror caerá en la fosa, \q y el que salga de la fosa quedará atrapado en la trampa. \q Porque las ventanas de lo alto se han abierto de par en par, \q y los cimientos de la tierra se estremecen.
es.R: El que huya de los ruidos de terror caerá en la fosa. \q El que salga de la fosa quedará atrapado en la trampa. \q Se han abierto las ventanas del cielo para derramar el agua, \q y la tierra tiembla hasta sus cimientos.

fr.L: Et il arrivera [que] celui qui fuit devant le bruit de la terreur tombera dans la fosse, \q et celui qui remonte du milieu de la fosse sera pris dans le piège ; \q car les fenêtres d’en haut se sont ouvertes, \q et les fondements de la terre ont tremblé.
fr.B: Celui qui fuira au bruit de l’épouvante tombera dans la fosse, \q et celui qui remontera de la fosse sera pris dans le filet. \q Car les fenêtres d’en haut se sont ouvertes, \q et les fondations de la terre tremblent.
fr.R: Celui qui s’enfuira en entendant les bruits de terreur tombera dans la fosse. \q Celui qui sortira de la fosse sera pris au piège. \q Les fenêtres du ciel se sont ouvertes pour déverser l’eau, \q et la terre tremble jusque dans ses fondations.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, yeye anayekimbia sauti ya hofu ataanguka shimoni, \q na yeye anayepanda kutoka katikati ya shimo atanaswa mtegoni; \q kwa maana madirisha ya juu yamefunguliwa, \q na misingi ya dunia imetikisika.
sw.B: Yeyote anayekimbia sauti ya hofu atatumbukia shimoni, \q na yeyote anayepanda kutoka shimoni atanaswa mtegoni. \q Kwa maana madirisha ya juu yamefunguliwa wazi, \q na misingi ya dunia inatetemeka.
sw.R: Yeyote anayekimbia sauti za hofu ataanguka shimoni. \q Yeyote anayepanda kutoka shimoni atanaswa mtegoni. \q Madirisha ya angani yamefunguliwa ili kumwaga maji, \q na dunia inatikisika mpaka misingi yake.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra, kẻ chạy trốn tiếng kinh hoàng sẽ rơi xuống hố sâu, \q và kẻ leo lên từ giữa hố sâu sẽ mắc vào cạm bẫy; \q vì các cửa sổ trên cao đã mở ra, \q và các nền của đất đã rung chuyển.
vi.B: Ai chạy trốn tiếng kinh hoàng sẽ sa xuống hố sâu, \q và ai leo ra khỏi hố sẽ mắc vào cạm bẫy. \q Vì các cửa sổ trên cao đã mở toang, \q và các nền của đất rung chuyển.
vi.R: Ai chạy trốn tiếng kinh hoàng sẽ rơi xuống hố. \q Ai leo ra khỏi hố sẽ bị mắc bẫy. \q Các cửa sổ trên trời đã mở ra để đổ nước xuống, \q và trái đất rung chuyển đến tận nền móng.

decisions.choice: whoever flees ... falls into the pit ... is caught in the snare: no escape
decisions.reason: Escaping one danger only leads into the next, as in Amos 5:19, where one flees a lion and meets a bear.

decisions.choice: windows from on high have been opened: a flood like Noah's
decisions.reason: The words recall the flood, when "the windows of the heavens were opened" (Genesis 7:11; 8:2). With the broken covenant of verse 5, the judgment is pictured as an undoing of the world.

decisions.choice: to pour down water
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the sky's windows, which in Genesis 7:11 let down the flood rain.

source.text: רֹ֥עָה הִֽתְרֹעֲעָ֖ה הָאָ֑רֶץ פּ֤וֹר הִֽתְפּוֹרְרָה֙ אֶ֔רֶץ מ֥וֹט הִֽתְמוֹטְטָ֖ה אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Utterly it has been broken, the earth; utterly it has been split, [the] earth; utterly it has been shaken, [the] earth.

en.L: Utterly broken is the earth; \q utterly split apart is [the] earth; \q utterly shaken is [the] earth.
en.B: The earth is shattered to pieces; \q the earth is torn right through; \q the earth reels and shudders.
en.R: The earth breaks into pieces. \q The earth splits wide open. \q The earth shakes violently.

es.L: Del todo quebrantada está la tierra; \q del todo partida está [la] tierra; \q del todo sacudida está [la] tierra.
es.B: La tierra se rompe en pedazos; \q la tierra se parte de lado a lado; \q la tierra se tambalea y se estremece.
es.R: La tierra se rompe en pedazos. \q La tierra se abre de par en par. \q La tierra tiembla con violencia.

fr.L: Entièrement brisée est la terre ; \q entièrement fendue est la terre ; \q entièrement ébranlée est la terre.
fr.B: La terre se brise en morceaux ; \q la terre se fend de part en part ; \q la terre chancelle et frémit.
fr.R: La terre se casse en morceaux. \q La terre s’ouvre en deux. \q La terre tremble violemment.

sw.L: Imevunjika kabisa dunia; \q imepasuka kabisa dunia; \q imetikisika kabisa dunia.
sw.B: Dunia imevunjika vipande vipande; \q dunia imepasuka katikati; \q dunia inayumba na kutetemeka.
sw.R: Dunia inavunjika vipande vipande. \q Dunia inapasuka wazi. \q Dunia inatikisika kwa nguvu.

vi.L: Đất bị vỡ tan hoàn toàn; \q đất bị nứt toác hoàn toàn; \q đất bị rung chuyển dữ dội.
vi.B: Mặt đất vỡ ra từng mảnh; \q mặt đất nứt toác ra; \q mặt đất lảo đảo rung chuyển.
vi.R: Trái đất vỡ ra từng mảnh. \q Trái đất nứt toác ra. \q Trái đất rung chuyển dữ dội.

decisions.choice: utterly broken ... split ... shaken: three doubled verbs
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, each verb is doubled for emphasis. The three verbs sound alike and build the picture of a great earthquake.

source.text: נ֣וֹעַ תָּנ֤וּעַ אֶ֨רֶץ֙ כַּשִּׁכּ֔וֹר וְהִֽתְנוֹדְדָ֖ה כַּמְּלוּנָ֑ה וְכָבַ֤ד עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ פִּשְׁעָ֔הּ וְנָפְלָ֖ה וְלֹא־תֹסִ֥יף קֽוּם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Wildly it will stagger, [the] earth, like the drunkard, and it will sway like the hut, and it will be heavy upon it, its rebellion, and it will fall and not will it again rise.

en.L: The earth will stagger, stagger like the drunkard, \q and it will sway like the hut; \q and its rebellion will be heavy upon it, \q and it will fall and will not rise again.
en.B: The earth will lurch to and fro like a drunk; \q it will rock like a watchman's shelter. \q Its rebellion will weigh it down; \q it will fall and not get up again.
en.R: The earth will stumble around like someone who is drunk. \q It will sway back and forth like a little shelter in a field. \q Its rebellion will be so heavy on it that it will fall down and never get up again.

es.L: Tambaleará, tambaleará la tierra como el borracho, \q y se mecerá como la choza; \q y pesará sobre ella su rebelión, \q y caerá y no volverá a levantarse.
es.B: La tierra se tambaleará de un lado a otro como un borracho; \q se mecerá como el cobertizo de un vigilante. \q Su rebelión pesará sobre ella; \q caerá y no volverá a levantarse.
es.R: La tierra dará tumbos como alguien que está borracho. \q Se mecerá de un lado a otro como una chocita en el campo. \q Su rebelión le pesará tanto que caerá y nunca más se levantará.

fr.L: La terre chancellera, chancellera comme l’ivrogne, \q et elle vacillera comme la cabane ; \q et sa révolte pèsera sur elle, \q et elle tombera et ne se relèvera plus.
fr.B: La terre titubera comme un homme ivre ; \q elle oscillera comme l’abri d’un gardien. \q Sa révolte l’écrasera de son poids ; \q elle tombera et ne se relèvera pas.
fr.R: La terre titubera comme quelqu’un qui a trop bu. \q Elle se balancera comme une petite cabane dans un champ. \q Sa révolte pèsera si lourd sur elle qu’elle tombera et ne se relèvera jamais.

sw.L: Dunia itayumbayumba, itayumba kama mlevi, \q nayo itayumba kama kibanda; \q na uasi wake utakuwa mzito juu yake, \q nayo itaanguka wala haitainuka tena.
sw.B: Dunia itapepesuka huku na huko kama mlevi; \q itayumba kama kibanda cha mlinzi. \q Uasi wake utailemea; \q itaanguka wala haitainuka tena.
sw.R: Dunia itapepesuka kama mtu aliyelewa. \q Itayumba huku na huko kama kibanda kidogo shambani. \q Uasi wake utakuwa mzito juu yake hata itaanguka chini na kamwe haitainuka tena.

vi.L: Đất sẽ lảo đảo, lảo đảo như kẻ say rượu, \q và nó sẽ lắc lư như cái chòi; \q và sự phản nghịch của nó sẽ đè nặng trên nó, \q và nó sẽ ngã xuống và không đứng dậy được nữa.
vi.B: Mặt đất sẽ chao đảo như người say rượu; \q nó sẽ lắc lư như chòi canh ngoài đồng. \q Tội phản nghịch của nó đè nặng trên nó; \q nó sẽ ngã xuống và không bao giờ đứng dậy nữa.
vi.R: Trái đất sẽ lảo đảo như người say rượu. \q Nó sẽ lắc qua lắc lại như một cái chòi nhỏ ngoài ruộng. \q Tội phản nghịch của nó nặng nề đến nỗi nó sẽ ngã xuống và không bao giờ đứng dậy được nữa.

decisions.choice: hut: a flimsy shelter for a watchman in a field
decisions.reason: The word names a light shelter put up for someone guarding a crop at night (1:8). In a storm it sways and falls.

decisions.choice: rebellion: breaking faith with God
decisions.reason: The word means revolt against a rightful ruler, as Israel's children "rebelled" against God in 1:2. Its weight is what brings the earth down.

decisions.choice: it will fall and not rise again: a final fall
decisions.reason: Amos 5:2 laments Israel in the same words: fallen, never to rise again.

decisions.choice: a watchman's shelter (Balanced); a little shelter in a field (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Hut" alone would not show why it sways; the word names a field-watchman's shelter.

source.text: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִפְקֹ֧ד יְהוָ֛ה עַל־צְבָ֥א הַמָּר֖וֹם בַּמָּר֑וֹם וְעַל־מַלְכֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה עַל־הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in that day, he will visit, Yahweh, upon the host of the height in the height, and upon the kings of the ground upon the ground.

en.L: And it will be in that day \q [that] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will visit [judgment] upon the host of the height in the height, \q and upon the kings of the ground upon the ground.
en.B: On that day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will call to account the army of the heights up on high \q and the kings of the earth down on the earth.
en.R: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will punish the powers of the sky, high above, \q and the kings who rule the earth, here below.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día \q [que] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} visitará [con castigo] al ejército de lo alto en lo alto, \q y a los reyes de la tierra sobre la tierra.
es.B: Aquel día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} pedirá cuentas al ejército de las alturas allá en lo alto \q y a los reyes de la tierra aquí en la tierra.
es.R: En ese tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} castigará a los poderes del cielo, allá en lo alto, \q y a los reyes que gobiernan la tierra, aquí abajo.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là \q [que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} visitera l’armée d’en haut, en haut, \q et les rois du sol, sur le sol.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} demandera des comptes à l’armée des hauteurs, là-haut, \q et aux rois de la terre, sur la terre.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} punira les puissances du ciel, tout là-haut, \q et les rois qui gouvernent la terre, ici-bas.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atalijilia [kwa hukumu] jeshi la juu huko juu, \q na wafalme wa ardhi juu ya ardhi.
sw.B: Siku hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atalihukumu jeshi la mbinguni huko juu \q na wafalme wa dunia huku chini duniani.
sw.R: Wakati huo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataadhibu nguvu za angani, huko juu, \q na wafalme wanaotawala dunia, huku chini.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ thăm phạt đạo binh của nơi cao trên nơi cao, \q và các vua của đất trên đất.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ trừng phạt đạo binh trên các tầng cao ở trên cao, \q và các vua trên đất ở dưới đất.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ trừng phạt các quyền lực trên bầu trời cao, \q và các vua cai trị trên mặt đất bên dưới.

decisions.choice: visit upon: punish, call to account
decisions.reason: To "visit upon" someone is to come and deal with their wrongs (10:12; 13:11).

decisions.choice: the host of the height: the powers of the heavens
decisions.reason: The host of heaven is the stars and the heavenly beings, which other nations worshiped (Deuteronomy 4:19; 2 Kings 21:5). Scripture also speaks of powers on high behind the kingdoms of earth (Daniel 10:13, 20). God judges both the powers above and the kings below.

decisions.choice: the army of the heights (Balanced); the powers of the sky (Readable); "earth" for the ground
decisions.reason: The word for host is the one for an army, as in "the LORD of hosts". Readable says "powers" because these are ruling beings, not soldiers.

decisions.choice: "trong ngày ấy" (L); "vào ngày ấy" (B); "vào lúc ấy" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for "in that day", used unchanged through these chapters.

source.text: וְאֻסְּפ֨וּ אֲסֵפָ֤ה אַסִּיר֙ עַל־בּ֔וֹר וְסֻגְּר֖וּ עַל־מַסְגֵּ֑ר וּמֵרֹ֥ב יָמִ֖ים יִפָּקֵֽדוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will be gathered, a gathering of prisoner[s] into a pit, and they will be shut up in a prison, and after many days they will be visited.

en.L: And they will be gathered [as] a gathering of prisoners into a pit, \q and they will be shut up in a prison, \q and after many days they will be visited.
en.B: They will be rounded up as prisoners are, into a pit, \q and locked away in a prison; \q after many days they will be brought to judgment.
en.R: They will be gathered together like prisoners and thrown into a deep pit. \q They will be locked up in a prison. \q After a long time, they will receive their punishment.

es.L: Y serán reunidos [como] se reúne a los presos en una fosa, \q y serán encerrados en una prisión, \q y después de muchos días serán visitados.
es.B: Serán agrupados como presos en una fosa \q y encerrados en una prisión; \q después de muchos días serán llevados a juicio.
es.R: Los juntarán como a presos y los echarán a una fosa profunda. \q Los encerrarán en una prisión. \q Después de mucho tiempo recibirán su castigo.

fr.L: Et ils seront rassemblés, un rassemblement de prisonniers, dans une fosse, \q et ils seront enfermés dans une prison, \q et après de nombreux jours ils seront visités.
fr.B: Ils seront rassemblés comme des prisonniers dans une fosse \q et enfermés dans une prison ; \q après de longs jours, ils passeront en jugement.
fr.R: Ils seront rassemblés comme des prisonniers et jetés dans une fosse profonde. \q Ils seront enfermés en prison. \q Longtemps après, ils recevront leur punition.

sw.L: Nao watakusanywa [kama] mkusanyiko wa wafungwa shimoni, \q nao watafungwa gerezani, \q na baada ya siku nyingi watajiliwa.
sw.B: Watakusanywa pamoja kama wafungwa, wakatiwe shimoni, \q na kufungiwa gerezani; \q baada ya siku nyingi wataletwa hukumuni.
sw.R: Watakusanywa pamoja kama wafungwa na kutupwa katika shimo refu. \q Watafungiwa gerezani. \q Baada ya muda mrefu, wataadhibiwa.

vi.L: Và họ sẽ bị gom lại [như] gom tù nhân vào hố sâu, \q và họ sẽ bị giam trong ngục, \q và sau nhiều ngày họ sẽ bị thăm phạt.
vi.B: Chúng sẽ bị dồn lại như tù nhân, bỏ vào hố sâu, \q và bị giam trong ngục; \q sau nhiều ngày, chúng sẽ bị xét xử.
vi.R: Chúng sẽ bị gom lại như tù nhân và bị ném xuống một cái hố sâu. \q Chúng sẽ bị giam trong ngục. \q Sau một thời gian dài, chúng sẽ chịu hình phạt.

decisions.choice: they will be visited: they will be punished
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in verse 21. Here it most likely means the final punishment after a time of imprisonment. It can also mean to visit with favor, which would mean release after many days.

decisions.choice: a pit: a cistern used as a prison
decisions.reason: Dry cisterns served as dungeons (Genesis 37:24; Jeremiah 38:6). The pit also suggests the world of the dead (14:15).

decisions.choice: shut up in a prison ... after many days: imprisonment before final judgment
decisions.reason: Revelation 20:1-3, 7-10 uses a similar pattern: the enemy is bound and locked away, then dealt with after a long time.

source.text: וְחָֽפְרָה֙ הַלְּבָנָ֔ה וּבוֹשָׁ֖ה הַֽחַמָּ֑ה כִּֽי־מָלַ֞ךְ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת בְּהַ֤ר צִיּוֹן֙ וּבִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְנֶ֥גֶד זְקֵנָ֖יו כָּבֽוֹד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And it will be abashed, the moon, and it will be ashamed, the sun, for he will reign, Yahweh of hosts, on [the] mountain of Zion and in Jerusalem, and before his elders [will be] glory.

en.L: And the moon will be abashed, and the sun will be ashamed, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, \q and before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} elders [will be] glory.
en.B: The moon will blush and the sun will hang its head, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies will reign as king on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, \q and before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} elders there will be glory.
en.R: The moon and the sun will seem to be ashamed, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies will rule as king on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem. \q The leaders of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people will see {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.

es.L: Y la luna se avergonzará, y el sol se sonrojará, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos reinará en el monte Sion y en Jerusalén, \q y delante de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ancianos [habrá] gloria.
es.B: La luna se ruborizará y el sol bajará la cabeza, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos reinará como rey en el monte Sion y en Jerusalén, \q y delante de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ancianos habrá gloria.
es.R: La luna y el sol parecerán avergonzados, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos reinará como rey en el monte Sion y en Jerusalén. \q Los jefes de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo verán {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.

fr.L: Et la lune rougira, et le soleil aura honte, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées régnera sur le mont Sion et à Jérusalem, \q et devant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} anciens [sera] la gloire.
fr.B: La lune rougira et le soleil baissera la tête, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées régnera en roi sur le mont Sion et à Jérusalem, \q et devant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} anciens éclatera la gloire.
fr.R: La lune et le soleil sembleront avoir honte, \q parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées régnera comme roi sur le mont Sion et à Jérusalem. \q Les chefs de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple verront {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.

sw.L: Na mwezi utaona haya, na jua litaaibika, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atatawala katika mlima Sayuni na katika Yerusalemu, \q na mbele ya wazee {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [kutakuwa na] utukufu.
sw.B: Mwezi utaona haya na jua litainamisha kichwa, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atatawala kama mfalme katika mlima Sayuni na katika Yerusalemu, \q na mbele ya wazee {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kutakuwa na utukufu.
sw.R: Mwezi na jua vitaonekana kama vinaona aibu, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atatawala kama mfalme katika mlima Sayuni na katika Yerusalemu. \q Viongozi wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wataona utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: Và mặt trăng sẽ hổ thẹn, và mặt trời sẽ xấu hổ, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ trị vì trên núi Si-ôn và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q và trước mặt các trưởng lão của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [sẽ có] vinh quang.
vi.B: Mặt trăng sẽ thẹn thùng, mặt trời sẽ cúi đầu xấu hổ, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ làm vua trên núi Si-ôn và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q và vinh quang sẽ rực rỡ trước mặt các trưởng lão của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Mặt trăng và mặt trời sẽ như phải xấu hổ, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ làm vua cai trị trên núi Si-ôn và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Các nhà lãnh đạo của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thấy vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: the moon ... the sun: their light fades before God's glory
decisions.reason: The words used are poetic names, "the white one" and "the hot one" (also 30:26). The lights once worshiped as part of the host of heaven (verse 21) are put to shame by God's glory (60:19-20).

decisions.choice: will reign: has become king
decisions.reason: The verb form can mean that the LORD has taken up his reign, as in the cry "Yahweh reigns" (Psalm 93:1; 52:7). Here it looks to the day of judgment.

decisions.choice: before his elders, glory: as at Sinai
decisions.reason: At Sinai the elders of Israel saw God and his glory rested on the mountain (Exodus 24:9-11, 16-17). The scene is renewed on Mount Zion.

decisions.choice: will seem to be ashamed; the leaders of his people will see his glory
decisions.reason: Readable marks the shame of the sun and moon as a picture and explains "his elders" as the leaders of God's people.
